={{ $json.erreur.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>') }} Prompt Bench bot Test a prompt from Telegram: each case runs 3 times, every answer is scored, and you get the pass rate, the cost of one call and a fixed prompt. /test [exact | judge | open] your prompt (one or more lines) cases: input => expected answer input => expected answer exact: the answer must match word for word. judge: a model checks it means the same. open: no expected answer, the model checks the output against your prompt. /status: your last 5 runs Example: 
/test judge
Classify the support ticket as billing, bug or other. Answer with one word.
cases:
I was charged twice => billing
The app crashes on login => bug

parameters.content:
## Bot Telegram : la porte d entree message

Restreint a ton chat (filtre du trigger). Le Switch aiguille la commande :

- **/test** : le message est analyse (prompt, cas, mode), valide par un IF, puis la campagne est lancee via le meme sous-workflow que le site. Le resultat revient dans le chat.
- **/status** : les 5 dernieres campagnes, lues dans Google Sheets.
- tout le reste : le mode d emploi, sans aucun appel au modele.
